---
title: "7_GSEA"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) using GO biological
  process gene sets. Genes ranked by sign(log2FC) x -log10(pvalue)
  to capture both direction and significance. Simplified output
  removes redundant GO terms. Run on all primary datasets.
  Results saved to GSEA/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("GSEA", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r gsea_function}
# ============================================================
# GSEA FUNCTION
# Args:
#   df      — DE results (gene, log2FC, pvalue)
#   gse_id  — dataset ID for file naming and titles
# Ranking: sign(log2FC) x -log10(pvalue + 1e-300)
# Small constant added to avoid log(0) for very small p-values
# ============================================================

run_gsea <- function(df, gse_id){

  cat("\n--- GSEA:", gse_id, "---\n")

  # create ranked gene list
  ranked <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = sign(log2FC) * -log10(pvalue + 1e-300)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(rank))

  gene_list        <- ranked$rank
  names(gene_list) <- ranked$gene

  cat("Genes in ranked list:", length(gene_list), "\n")

  # run GSEA
  gsea_result <- gseGO(
    geneList      = gene_list,
    OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType       = "SYMBOL",
    ont           = "BP",
    minGSSize     = 10,
    maxGSSize     = 500,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    verbose       = FALSE
  )

  if(nrow(gsea_result@result) == 0){
    cat("No significant GSEA terms for:", gse_id, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # simplify
  gsea_simplified <- simplify(
    gsea_result,
    cutoff      = 0.7,
    by          = "p.adjust",
    select_fun  = min
  )

  cat("Significant terms (simplified):",
      nrow(gsea_simplified@result), "\n")

  # split activated vs suppressed
  activated  <- gsea_simplified@result %>%
    filter(NES > 0) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
  suppressed <- gsea_simplified@result %>%
    filter(NES < 0) %>% arrange(p.adjust)

  cat("Activated pathways:", nrow(activated), "\n")
  cat("Suppressed pathways:", nrow(suppressed), "\n")

  # dotplot
  p <- dotplot(gsea_simplified,
               split    = ".sign",
               showCategory = 15) +
    facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
    labs(title = paste(gse_id, "GSEA GO BP (Simplified)"))

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("GSEA/", gse_id, "_GSEA_dotplot.png"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 14,
    height   = 12,
    dpi      = 300
  )

  # save results
  write.csv(
    gsea_simplified@result,
    paste0("GSEA/", gse_id, "_GSEA_GO.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  return(gsea_simplified@result)
}
```

```{r run_gsea_all_datasets}
# ============================================================
# RUN GSEA ON ALL PRIMARY DATASETS
# ============================================================

gsea_datasets <- c(
  "GSE3307",   # ALS primary — expect muscle contraction suppressed
  "GSE140089", # PD primary — expect OXPHOS activated
  "GSE128177", # PD shared cohort — replication check
  "GSE122261", # ALS cell line
  "GSE26276",  # ALS directional only
  "GSE30806",  # VCP-myopathy
  "GSE12685",  # AD brain
  "GSE28146"   # AD brain
)

gsea_results <- list()

for(gse_id in gsea_datasets){
  try({
    de_file <- paste0("DE_Results/", gse_id, "_DE_results.csv")

    if(!file.exists(de_file)){
      cat("DE results not found:", gse_id, "\n")
      next
    }

    df <- read.csv(de_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    gsea_results[[gse_id]] <- run_gsea(df, gse_id)
  })
}

cat("\n=== GSEA SUMMARY ===\n")
for(gse_id in names(gsea_results)){
  if(!is.null(gsea_results[[gse_id]])){
    n_act <- sum(gsea_results[[gse_id]]$NES > 0)
    n_sup <- sum(gsea_results[[gse_id]]$NES < 0)
    cat(gse_id, "— Activated:", n_act,
        "| Suppressed:", n_sup, "\n")
  }
}

cat("\nGSEA results saved to GSEA/\n")
list.files("GSEA")
```
